nora: quick heads-up from reranker-intl bringup. overall NDCG@10 +1.6% but MRR@10 -3.9%. biggest drops on accented/multilang queries (es/fr).
sam: interesting. any preproc differences vs offline eval? unicode normalization?
nora: i ran the staging pipeline with `norm=form_c` (NFC) while our offline harness used `norm=form_d` (NFD). also we enabled accent-folding for search tokens in the retrieval layer last week.
vik: that can change token boundaries under sentencepiece and compress score gaps when quantized. did you test fp32 vs int8?
nora: yes:
- fp32 (NFD, no-accent-fold): ndcg +0.8, mrr -0.4
- int8 (NFC, accent-fold): ndcg +1.6, mrr -3.9
so int8 amplifies the MRR hit with normalization+folding.
sam: can you paste the eval command and the small repro run?
nora: ```
./eval_rerank --gold holdout_multilang.json --pred preds_rerank_intl.json --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 --slices accented_queries,english_queries --tokenizer spm_v3 --preproc-config preproc_intl.yaml
```
repro snippet:
```bash
python tools/repro_unicode.py --qids accented_sample_250.json --model rerank-intl-int8 --norm NFC --accent-fold true
```
vik: curious if it's mostly tie-breaking or a true scoring shift. any example qids?
nora: uploaded diffs and cases to s3://redwood-eval/artifacts/rerank/intl/1888000001/ (examples.jsonl + score_diffs.csv). One example: qid=Q-ES-42, fp32 ranks [D3,D1,D7], int8 ranks [D1,D3,D7] and gold is D3 -> MRR drops. score gap was 0.002 in fp32, compressed to 0.0001 after quant.
sam: classic score-compression induced tie flip. mitigation ideas: 1) require preproc normalization parity (include unicode norm and accent-fold flags) in onboarding artifact, 2) short accented-slice CI smoke (~250 qids) fail if MRR drops >2% vs fp32, 3) add deterministic tie-breaker by stable doc_id bias pre-softmax.
vik: also consider adding a small calibration offset per-language or per-slice in eval harness to detect compression anomalies early (alert on large delta between ndcg and mrr).
nora: i'll open PRs: onboarding schema update to include `unicode_norm` and `accent_fold`, CI smoke job, and model card note "sensitive: unicode normalization + accent folding under quantization". will also link artifacts.
mlops-bot: staging snapshot created: rerank-intl-2026-03-30T11:12:00Z :rocket:
sam: extra ask: add a preflight check in the deployment pipeline that compares preproc checksum + norm flags to the offline-golden used during eval. fail fast.
vik: agreed. and add a quick unit test for sentencepiece tokenization parity on accented inputs to the eval harness.
nora: thanks — PRs queued, tagging reviewers. resolving until PRs land.
